artworks.title: The Unsafe Tenement
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image features a view looking slightly upward at an old, rustic building. The focus is on the structure itself, displaying detailed textures created through etching. The building is depicted with intricate lines, conveying the appearance of weathered wood and aged masonry. Near an entrance, a figure is seen standing in a shadowed area, adding depth and scale to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, grey, and off-white to evoke antiquity and somberness. The background is obscured, highlighting the building within the frame.

artworks.title: Bibi Valentin
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows a young child in a relaxed seated pose. The child has a slight lean, with their head tilted and gazing straight ahead. The facial features are depicted with large eyes, a small nose, and medium-length hair. The child wears a loose-fitting outfit with long sleeves and a high collar. They are barefoot, with one leg extended forward and the other bent at the knee. The background is minimalistic with faint horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Thames Warehouses
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Josephine Boardman Crane, 1954)
artworks.description: The image displays a waterfront scene with ships docked at a wharf. The masts of the ships are visible along the horizon. People are seen on boats in the foreground, while larger ships and buildings populate the docking area. There is a plume of smoke in the distance, and the scene is depicted in a detailed, sketch-like style using a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: The 'Adam and Eve', Old Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The etching shows a view from above a street, overlooking a river and a row of buildings. There are moored boats with tall masts on the left side, and buildings along the riverbank. The intricate linework is typical of an etching, capturing architectural details. The monochromatic palette conveys depth through line density and shading, creating a play of light and shadow. The densely grouped buildings in the distance feature signs and architectural details, depicting an urban scene.

artworks.title: Bead-Stringers
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to the platemark): 23.02 × 15.4 cm (9 1/16 × 6 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic interior scene with figures engaged in various activities. The setting appears to be a small, enclosed space. The drawing is composed predominantly of intricate line work and hatching. In the center, a window with shuttered blinds is discernible, casting soft light into the room. Below the window, a group is gathered, with a central figure holding what could be a child. The lines are gestural and the forms are hinted rather than explicitly detailed, suggesting a moment frozen in casual intimacy. The overall tone of the drawing is warm and homey, despite the minimalistic and sketch-like execution.

artworks.title: Ponte del Piovan
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from a canal perspective looking up towards a stone bridge. The water reflects the structures above, with the bridge forming a prominent horizontal line across the image. Two figures are seen interacting on the bridge. Beyond the bridge, buildings rise vertically with balconies and archways in the urban landscape. The horizon is not visible in the composition, which focuses on the city structures. The brushstrokes are delicate and intricate, capturing details and textures in the stonework and water surface. The monochromatic palette in shades of sepia or light brown gives a classic, timeless quality to the scene, echoing the historic architecture depicted.

artworks.title: Jo's Bent Head
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the Women's Committee of the Corcoran Gallery of Art, 1956)
artworks.description: The image displays a partial depiction of a person, focusing on the head and shoulders in profile view. The facial features appear serene, with closed eyes and dark, flowing hair. The background is plain with subtle texture indicating the medium of the artwork.

artworks.title: Annie, Seated
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl seated with her full upper body visible and slightly more than half of her lower body, down to the knees. Her head is tilted downwards, and her hands are folded in her lap. The girl's facial features are delicately rendered with soft lines portraying her eyes, nose, and mouth. Her mid-length, slightly wavy hair falls around her shoulders. She is wearing a long garment, likely a dress, with ample fabric creating folds and a voluminous shape around her legs. The chair she sits on is lightly outlined in the background, which is plain and unadorned with subtle shading suggesting the ground beneath the chair. Crosshatching details add depth and dimension to the scene.

artworks.title: Edmond Pigalle
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image depicts a half-length profile of a seated person. The individual is turned slightly to their right, with their chin resting on their right hand. Their facial features are delicately sketched, showing a prominent nose and closed lips. They wear a dark hat and a loose-fitting, long-sleeved garment with folds and shading. There is a decorative clasp or fur detail on the sleeve. The background is plain with some text at the top left, likely an artist's signature or date. The artwork is rendered in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: A  Family (Une Famille)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and soft ground on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up view of four individuals, showcasing various parts of their faces and torsos. The central figure has medium-length hair and delicate features including a small nose and downturned lips, viewed in profile. The person behind them has shorter hair and prominent eyes looking at the viewer, with a fringe of bangs on their forehead. In the lower left corner, there is a profile view of another person with wavy hair and a straight nose, mostly obscured by shadow. On the right, only the shaded facial profile of another person is visible, with features rendered in a rough texture. The textured background adds depth to the composition, while the etching technique gives the image a soft, intricate quality.

artworks.title: World Fliers, Portsmouth
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1931)
artworks.description: The image shows bi-planes flying in formation across a sky with clouds. The perspective is looking upward, with the horizon positioned low, implying a coastline or open sea. The artwork features fine lines to depict movement in the planes and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily beige and gray, emphasizing the atmospheric quality. The horizon line suggests the meeting of sea and sky, while details of clouds and planes are more pronounced in the foreground.

artworks.title: Sea Pasture
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene from an elevated perspective. It depicts a body of water with a rugged shoreline in the distance. The horizon, rocky hills, cliffs, two boats on the water, and wave motion are all captured in intricate, swirling lines. The artwork is done using fine, controlled linework resembling an etching, in a monochromatic palette of black or dark sepia on a cream background.

artworks.title: Bacchus
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in dynamic poses, seemingly in mid-movement. Their positions suggest fluid motion with arms raised. The figures' facial features are indistinct and heavily shaded, with voluminous, flowing hair. Each figure is draped in light, fabric-like clothing that adheres to their forms. The background is filled with dense, textured shading. In the bottom left corner, there are additional indistinct shapes. Another smaller sketch on the lower right depicts a figure in a similar pose.

artworks.title: Verite
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image portrays a seated woman with one leg crossed over the other. Her torso is turned slightly to the left. She has a serene expression and wavy hair. She is nude with a light piece of fabric draped over her lap and around her left side. She holds a round object attached to this fabric in her right hand. The background is dark and textured, creating a spotlight effect that highlights the woman's form.

artworks.title: Two Boats at Sail (Les deux Barques à voile)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a view of the shoreline and sea from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is in the center, with two distant windmills visible. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, depicting textures and shapes without excessive detail. The artwork uses a monochrome palette of black and white. Close to us, a pathway runs parallel to the shoreline leading to small houses on the left, bordered by trees. A sailboat is seen sailing on the water to the right. The sky has clouds depicted with sparse, curved lines.

artworks.title: Charity (La Charité)
artworks.medium: etching printed in brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly figure sitting on the ground with a bowl in their outstretched hand. Two cloaked figures approach them. The seated figure leans against a stone wall, with two crutches resting beside them. The two standing figures are facing each other, with one extending a hand. The background features an arched stone structure with leaded glass windows. The drawing uses fine lines and hatching techniques.

artworks.title: Returning with the Hay (Rentrant le Foin)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path where a horse is pulling a cart uphill, with two individuals pushing from behind. In the distance, there is a small building or tower. The artwork uses fine etching techniques with crosshatching to depict the textures of the cart, figures, and fields. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying intensities of black and white for contrast. The artwork depicts detailed movements of the horse and figures in the foreground, fading into rolling hills and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Plain (La Plaine)
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon line is low and indistinct, blending into softly rolling hills stretching into the distance. There are fields with faint indications of vegetation or cultivated land in the foreground. The style features intricate and densely woven etch marks creating texture and depth with a cross-hatching technique. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black providing contrast and detail. Closest to us, there is an area with denser, darker strokes suggesting foliage or shrubs. In the background, the sky is depicted with swirling, cross-hatched lines, creating a cloudy appearance.

artworks.title: Banks of the Venelle (Bord de la Venelle)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river viewed from a slightly elevated vantage point. The horizon is situated toward the upper third of the image, surrounded by trees and shrubs. The image appears to be an etching, with delicate, linear strokes creating depth and detail in the natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and off-white to render the scene. A reclining figure is partially visible close to the viewer, with a calm river flowing through the center of the image. In the distance, a variety of trees forms a dense forest canopy contrasting with the open waterway.

artworks.title: Le Wagg-Poids de la Ville d'Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows an urban scene with a wide perspective that includes a busy street, canal area, and a central historical building with pointed roofs and turrets. The foreground features a cobblestone path with carts and barrels. People populate a bustling market area. To the right, boats with tall masts dock by the water, with smaller boats in the canal. The artwork depicts intricate architectural details, cobblestones, and water texture with fine detail in a monochromatic color palette characteristic of a drawing or etching. Cloud formations in the sky are subtly rendered with delicate lines.

artworks.title: Fete Venetienne sur la Seine
artworks.medium: wood engraving
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a nighttime scene with fireworks lighting up the sky on the right side. In the background, there is an arched stone bridge across a river. Closest to us, there are several boats filled with people and adorned with glowing paper lanterns. The painting contains a mix of delicate and bold brushstrokes, with a monochromatic color palette of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: The Wool Carder (La Cardeuse)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the knees up working with a tool. She has a concentrated expression with detailed facial features. She is wearing a headscarf and a long, loose-fitting garment with long sleeves. She is sitting on a wooden chair surrounded by a spinning wheel and wool or fleece on the floor. The background is textured and there are shelves or a tabletop partially visible behind her.

artworks.title: The Gleaners (Les Glanenses)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures working in a field. They are dressed in long garments and head coverings, gathering bundles of crops. In the background are haystacks, a wagon, and a horizon blending into a lightly detailed sky with wispy clouds. The artwork is done using fine lines and cross-hatching to create shading and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of various shades of a single, soft hue.

artworks.title: Desert Cedars, New Mexico
artworks.medium: etching in blue-black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image features a detailed view of a large, gnarled tree in the foreground, set against a horizon with distant mesas and rolling hills. The horizon line includes cliffs and rock formations. The etching captures the textures of the tree's bark and leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black. Whimsically drawn clouds are scattered across the sky and landscape.
